item.description:
Aki 0.5.0

Your week at a glance

  • A ring for Claude and one for Codex at the end of the sidebar: how much of the weekly limit is used and how much of today's share, in colour (green, yellow from 50%, orange from 70%, red from 90%).
  • Hover a ring: when each window renews, whether you're over or under the pace, today's tokens and what they'd cost at API prices, the last 7 days and the projects that used most.
  • Settings → Show in the sidebar: sessions and limits, only limits (a usage meter) or only sessions.
  • aki usage prints it in the terminal.
  • Read from Claude Code's and Codex's own logs on your Mac — only the token counts, never the conversations.

item.title: 0.5.0-beta.3
item.description:
Aki 0.5.0 beta 3

  • Limits rings and bars change colour as the week fills: green, yellow from 50%, orange from 70%, red from 90%.

Aki 0.4.4

  • The right session, by itself: marking starts on the agent tab you're in, or were in a moment ago, before the page's port.
  • ⌘Z undoes the last mark.
  • Space held while dragging moves the whole area, as the Mac's ⌘⇧4.
  • ⇧ in the middle of a drag no longer gets in the way.

Aki 0.4.3

  • Add up with ⇧ and the arrows: the next thing joins what's outlined, and ⏎ marks them as one area. The opposite arrow takes the last one back out.
  • Bigger and smaller are now ⌘↑ / ⌘↓.
  • Hold ⇧ to use the page below while marking: click, hover, open its menus. Let go and Aki is back with a fresh picture.
  • Each session has its own colour, so a mark's colour says where it goes.
